name: Claude Opus 4.8 + Dynamic Workflows (v2.1.154)
hook: v2.1.154 shipped May 28, 41 days after Opus 4.7. Three things landed together: Opus 4.8 (agentic coding 64.3%→69.2%, 4× less likely to let code flaws go unflagged, misalignment score now on par with Mythos Preview at 1.9); Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code (research preview) — Claude writes a JS orchestration script on the fly, fans work across up to 1,000 subagents (16 concurrent), deploys adversarial refutation agents, and resumes jobs from checkpoints; and Fast Mode at 3× cheaper and 2.5× faster than Opus 4.7 fast mode. Demo: Jarred Sumner ported Bun from Zig to Rust in 11 days — 750k lines of Rust, 99.8% test suite passing.

name: awesome-design-md (VoltAgent)
hook: 85.6k stars, #150 globally on GitHub. 73 brand DESIGN.md files — Apple, Stripe, Notion, Linear, Tesla, Claude, OpenAI, Figma, Vercel, Spotify, Nike, Ferrari, and 61 more — each encoding a complete visual system as plain markdown that Claude Code reads as context. Drop one into your project root and Claude generates UI that matches that brand's color palette, typography, spacing, and hierarchy in one pass. No install needed; copy-paste workflow.
install: cp awesome-design-md/design-md/stripe.md ./DESIGN.md  # See README for all 73 brands

name: Codeburn (AgentSeal)
hook: 7.3k stars, v0.9.11 released May 27. Interactive TUI dashboard + macOS menubar widget that reads Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 22 other AI coding assistant session logs directly from disk — no API keys or proxies needed. Per-project cost breakdowns, 13 task categories (coding, debugging, feature dev, testing, and more), one-shot success rates, cache hit tracking, and CSV/JSON export. Optimize Mode identifies wasteful patterns: repeated file reads, idle MCP servers, redundant context loads. Developers Digest called it
install: npm install -g codeburn  # or: brew install codeburn  # or: npx codeburn

name: mattpocock/skills (Matt Pocock)
hook: 111k stars, +1,618 stars in one week (GitHub Weekly Trending). Matt Pocock (author of Total TypeScript) distilled engineering practice into five behavioral constraints: /grill-me interrogates your plan before a single line is written; /grill-with-docs adds domain documentation to the interrogation; /tdd locks in red-green-refactor; /diagnose structures debugging; /improve-codebase-architecture detects and repairs design drift. A CONTEXT.md file builds shared vocabulary so Claude uses your codebase's actual terminology consistently.

name: CC Switch (farion1231)
hook: 84.6k stars, v3.15.0. Cross-platform Tauri desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) that centralizes Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent in one GUI. 50+ API provider presets for one-click backend switching, unified MCP server management, system tray quick-switch, cloud sync via Dropbox/iCloud/OneDrive/WebDAV, session browser, and per-tool spending tracker. The single-pane replacement for manually editing env vars and config files across six CLI tools.
install: brew install --cask cc-switch  # Windows/Linux: see ccswitch.io

name: "Claude Opus 4.8: a modest but tangible improvement" (Willison)
hook: Simon Willison published a May 28 take noting Anthropic's refreshing self-description of Opus 4.8 as "a modest but tangible improvement" — a rare instance of an AI lab not overselling a release. He characterizes the key upgrade as honesty: Opus 4.8 flags code problems rather than quietly shipping them. A grounding editorial counterpoint to the week's hype cycle around Dynamic Workflows; useful framing for teams deciding whether the upgrade justifies any workflow disruption.

name: awesome-design-skills (bergside)
hook: 1k stars. 67 design-system SKILL.md files for Claude Code and compatible agents — each file encodes a complete aesthetic identity as an installable skill rather than a static DESIGN.md.
